Global (All).title: Ransomware attacks targeting critical infrastructure in Ukraine
Global (All).summary: Russian-linked hackers have been launching cyberattacks on Ukraine's critical infrastructure, including energy and defense systems, using ransomware.

Global (All).title: Iran's President-elect warns West against 'bullying'
Global (All).summary: Iran's President-elect Ebrahim Raisi has warned the West against 'economic bullying' and said the country will not renegotiate the nuclear deal.

Global (All).title: Facebook and Instagram face new EU data security probes
Global (All).summary: Facebook and Instagram are facing new investigations from EU regulators over concerns about data security and potential breaches of consumer rights.

United States.summary: Violent Protests Break Out in Downtown Los Angeles on August 1, 2024, Over Police Brutality Allegations. Several people were arrested, and property damage occurred. The protests are part of a larger nationwide movement protesting police brutality.

A Cyber Attack Hits Major US Bank on July 25, 2024, Exposing Customer Data. The bank has assured customers that their data is secure, but the attack has raised concerns about cybersecurity in the financial sector.

Supreme Court Justice's Personal Residence Vandalized on July 29, 2024, Amidst Ongoing Tensions Over Judicial Appointments. The incident has sparked security concerns for high-profile individuals in the US.

Japan.title: Japan's ruling LDP to hold presidential election
Japan.summary: Japan's ruling Liberal Democratic Party is set to hold a presidential election, which could lead to a change in leadership and potentially impact the country's policy direction.

Japan.title: North Korea fires two ballistic missiles into East Sea
Japan.summary: North Korea fired two ballistic missiles into the East Sea, sparking concern among regional leaders and raising tensions in the area.

Japan.title: Japan's government warns of potential cyber attack on power grid
Japan.summary: Japan's government has warned of a potential cyber attack on the country's power grid, which could have devastating consequences for the country's energy infrastructure.
